test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a097af5d41d0b9d49c79d05da55fcebb428aa39ca0c49809784b3dc786281453.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Middle figure straight line rotated 45º clockwise direction, and one line is added after every rotation in the next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70d2e03088b981864e3380b61db867d84079e21f489ba7c685077e5407af4bb0.png] 

2) In every next figure one dot is added in the anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bccae148c43f3ad8b8662a5c027a352e5711ca6c463bfa5cc018801c5a2fea89.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
